---
title: Data Cleaning
format: typst
---

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

sov <- read_csv("data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")

id_cols <- c("COUNTY", "FIPS", "SVPREC", "SVPREC_KEY", "GEO_TYPE")

sov_clean <- sov |>
    mutate(across(
        .cols = -all_of(id_cols),
        .fns = ~ as.numeric(str_replace(.x, "<10", "5"))
    ))

sov_clean <- sov_clean |>
    mutate(CDDIST = as.integer(CDDIST))

summary(sov_clean$TOTVOTE)
range(sov_clean$CDDIST, na.rm = TRUE)
sum(is.na(sov_clean$TOTVOTE))

write_csv(sov_clean, "data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
sov_clean <- read_csv("data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")

sov_cong <- sov_clean |>
mutate(
DEM = rowSums(across(starts_with("CNGDEM")), na.rm = TRUE),
REP = rowSums(across(starts_with("CNGREP")), na.rm = TRUE),
TOTAL = DEM + REP
) |>
filter(TOTAL > 0)

set.seed(133) # for reproducibility
sov_cong_new <- sov_cong |>
mutate(new_dist = sample(1:52, n(), replace = TRUE))
```
